title: Wood firing in CSU Sacramento ceramics courses
kiln_style: Kusakabe smokeless wood kiln; bourry box
how_to_join: Enroll in ceramics courses at Sacramento State. Firings are run with enrolled students; there are no public firings.
manual_note: Added by hand from the research: air-district record BACT #174 (wood-fired ceramic kiln, 6000 J St) and Levin map pin (CSU bourry box). The university website lists no firings.
